notes: Single machine-readable definition of the native boundary (docs/OTA.md section 3). Read by tools/ota_runtime.py, tools/ota/classify.py, tools/ota_build_payload.sh, tools/ota_inspect_pack.gd and the publish workflow.

Matching is case-sensitive on a root-relative path with '/' separators (no 'res://', no leading './'): exact = whole path, prefixes = begins with, suffixes = ends with. native_inputs entries are exact paths or globs ('*' does not cross '/', '**' does).

Category per changed source path (tools/ota/classify.py): native_inputs first (APK required: the runtime fingerprint would change), then not_shipped, then payload_protected (APK required), then guarded, otherwise safe.
A path inside a payload pack is checked against payload_protected and guarded using its raw name AND its source name (pack_aliases: 'x.gd.remap' and 'x.gdc' both map to 'x.gd').

Native-code suffixes are protected anywhere in a pack, a deliberate superset of 'addons/**/*.gdextension|*.so|*.dll|*.dylib'. ota/ (this file and runtime_lock.json) is protected too: a boundary change must never be able to weaken itself over the air.
